messages:
clara: Quick proposal: migrate console analytics from envelope rows to compact metric_windows partitioned by day keyed (route_tag, tenant_id, window_start). Aim: faster dashboard rollups and simpler rollouts.
mike: sounds promising. Biggest risks? backfill cost and ad-hoc JSON queries that teams rely on.
dina: plan: dual-write for 60 days, backfill in 1h windows with rate cap, keep envelope_events immutable for ad-hoc searches. We'll denorm top filter fields into metric_windows.
jorge: runtime quota check path must stay sub-ms. Keep a small current_window cache in redis updated by ingest; fallback to metric_windows if cache miss.
clara: DDL sketch:
```sql
CREATE TABLE metric_windows (route_tag TEXT, tenant_id UUID, window_start TIMESTAMP, requests BIGINT, tokens BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY(route_tag, tenant_id, window_start)) PARTITION BY RANGE(window_start);
```
mike: monitoring: expose metric_windows_backfill_progress, dualwrite_mismatch_rate. Console should show per-tenant migration status (not-started/migrating/migrated).
dina: rollout UX: tenant opt-in from Console -> Admin. Start backfill + enable dualwrite for that tenant. Canary plan: staging 30m, 0.5% prod, 5% prod, full.
clara: action items: 1) route_meta denorm schema (mike) 2) ingest dual-write patch (dina) 3) backfill job with checkpointing (dina) 4) console migration panel prototype (ping ben-console).
console-bot: schema-compat CI green for branch "metric-windows-proto" https://ci.company/5678 :white_check_mark: +
